inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A fortified kill zone: sharpened spike walls, a catapult aimed at the arena, a horned beast chained to a tree, skulls on pikes, war banners, and a cheerful skeleton merchant selling souvenirs.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Bright warm daylight from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#f6e4c4", "#9692c4", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#d04a3a", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#3a3a52", "#e8e0d0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky over a distant ridge. Along the back stands a row of ruins: an obelisk at the far left, a broken colonnade, the temple crypt in the middle with a brazier each side of its doorway, a ruined hut with ladders, a huge tree at the right, with coffins, a cart of skulls and pots in front of them. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even. A fallen column and a giant fallen statue head frame the bottom corners in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 420, 105], "desc": "a tall stone obelisk used as a scoreboard, rows of notches carved down its side, skulls on top"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [130, 55, 410, 325], "desc": "a broken colonnade fortified with sharpened wooden spike barricades and skulls on pikes"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 370, 430, 635], "desc": "the sunken crypt temple fortified with spike walls and red war banners, its doorway dark, two braziers burning"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [140, 600, 420, 860], "desc": "a wooden catapult aimed at the arena, a pile of boulders beside it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 790, 420, 1000], "desc": "a huge horned beast chained to a big tree, snarling"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 250, 470, 1000], "desc": "a little souvenir stall with helmets and flags for sale, a betting board, skeleton spectators on a small wooden stand"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright clear sky with circling vultures over the long Bloodridge burial ridge on the horizon, carved with tomb terraces and dark tomb doors, the chief's stepped pyramid court on its crest"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [420, 60, 1000, 940], "desc": "a calm packed grey stone arena with faint painted lines, nothing busy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 230], "desc": "sharpened wooden stakes"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [800, 830, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a giant fallen statue head with a war banner planted in it"}]}}
